label: PF Backlog 122
title: API-first exposure for all new pipeline capabilities
body:
CONVENTION (owner): everything on the pipeline backend is API-first. Every new capability in this program (phases 0b-0e / 13-13b, agent roster, AI-integration recommendation, dynamic tailoring, pipeline templates, dynamic agent creation, dynamic knowledge/skill acquisition, business-models KB, model-tier, runtime integration) MUST be exposed through the backend API (dashboard/api or core API layer) with a stable contract; the dashboard consumes ONLY the API (no direct store writes). Add/extend routes + request/response models + auth; document the contract.
API-FIRST (owner convention): expose this capability through the backend API with a stable contract; the dashboard consumes ONLY the API (no direct store access/writes).

dashboard_impact.reason: Cross-cutting API-exposure convention; the dashboard consumes the API surface (no new UI of its own).
